preview.synopsis: Bielefeld have won their last two home meetings; Magdeburg are the more clinical side. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Sixth on 17 points, four wins in last five, unbeaten in five at home; solid defensively (second-best shots on target conceded) but second-worst shots on target. Grodowski top scorer (7). Felix out.
strengths.away: Fourth on 20 points, 4-1 win over St. Pauli last time; best big-chance conversion in the league but winless in four away games. Zukowski has scored in four of last four.

preview.synopsis: Heidenheim have the stronger underlying numbers and won the last meeting 1-0; Darmstadt are struggling. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: 17th with nine points, lost 2-0 at Nurnberg, worst shot accuracy in the league and only 1.06 xG per match; four unbeaten at home. Lee and Pfeiffer doubts.
strengths.away: Seventh on 16 points but three draws and two losses in last five; xG 2.26 per match, best aerial goal threat (headed goals) and second-best xGA. Zivzivadze top scorer (4).

preview.synopsis: Aarhus are favourites on form and head-to-head despite injuries; Lyngby drew 2-2 at home earlier. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Eighth on 15 points, 3 wins in last 5, unbeaten in four at home and unbeaten against Lyngby since 2019; poor shot accuracy and top scorer Serra plus Tingager out.
strengths.away: 10th on 11 points, one win in last five, lost last three away; worst big-chance conversion and rarely score headers. Colyn top scorer (5).

preview.author: Matthew Billon

pick.selection: Bayern Munich to win by 3+ goals
pick.text: Bayern Munich are rightful favourites here and should realistically put Cologne to the sword, so backing Bayern Munich to win by 3+ goals could squeeze some value out of their favouritism.

preview.synopsis: Bayern are strong favourites with a huge H2H record; the writer backs Bayern to win by 3+ goals.

strengths.home: Top of the Bundesliga on goal difference, unbeaten in all competitions (W11, D5); conceded only one first-half goal and scored first in most rounds. Davies injured; Kompany back.
strengths.away: Eight of ten league goals after half-time, led at the break in one game; unbeaten-run record against Bayern is W20 D2 for Bayern. Said and Malek El Mala their threats.

preview.author: John Pennington

pick.text: As these two sides have averaged fewer than one goal scored per league game this season, backing under 2.5 goals could be worth considering here.

preview.synopsis: Two low-scoring sides averaging under a goal each; the writer suggests under 2.5 goals.

strengths.home: Newly promoted, two wins from eight league games, failed to score in six; four points from the last three and a 2-0 win at home last time. Diaz suspended.
strengths.away: Lost only two of last seven H2Hs and of last 12 against promoted clubs; score late away (four after the 75th minute). No new injury concerns.

preview.synopsis: Two leaky defences and a high-scoring head-to-head (3.6 goals per game). AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: 16th on nine points, 1-0 win last time but two wins in 11; won last two meetings and unbeaten in four at home against Westerlo. Fewest passes in the league; Ngoura top scorer.
strengths.away: Ninth on 14 points, lost 5-1 at home to Charleroi, winless in three; 2.8 conceded per match recently and worst in the league for big chances conceded. Bassette has 8 goals; Diong suspended.

preview.author: Matt Jones

pick.text: The hosts’ strong form at San Mamés makes backing Ath Bilbao to win with a clean sheet an alluring option.

preview.synopsis: Athletic are strong at San Mames; the writer picks Athletic to win with a clean sheet.

strengths.home: Seventh on 16 points, unbeaten in four (W3, D1) and five at home with three clean sheets; Berenguer in form. Winless when conceding first. Serrano doubtful, Sannadi out.
strengths.away: Most yellow cards in La Liga, winless in six when conceding first; goalkeeper Fortuno has the best save percentage (86%). No major new injuries.

preview.synopsis: Wednesday have the better form and quality; Barnsley are bottom and bruised. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: 23rd with nine points, nine games without a win, four losses in last five; create many shots but worst duel win rate and concede many big chances. McGeehan suspended.
strengths.away: Fifth on 23 points, 3-0 win last time but one win in last five and winless in three away; strong xG on target. Keillor-Dunn, a former Barnsley player, leads with four goals.
